tools.name: request_demo
tools.description: Request a personalized demo of Precoro, a procurement and accounts payable automation platform. Fills in and submits the demo request form on this page. Only use details the user has explicitly provided and agreed to share with Precoro. A business email is required: personal addresses (for example Gmail or Outlook.com) are rejected. After a successful request, a scheduling window may open on the page where the user picks a meeting time.

email.description: User's business email address, e.g. name@company.com.

phone.description: User's phone number in international format with the country code, e.g. +14155550123.

companySize.description: Number of employees in the user's company.
